answer_2.quote: Metrics The evaluation metrics we use include: • POS accuracy (POS): The accuracy of the POS tags... • Non-lexicalized morphological features accuracy (TAGS): The accuracy of the combined 14 morphological features... • Diacritization accuracy (DIAC): The accuracy of the diacritized forms... • CODA-based normalization accuracy (CODA): The accuracy of the CODAnormalized, and diacritized, EGY forms... • Lemmatization accuracy (LEMMA): Lemma accuracy... • Full Analysis Accuracy (FULL): Accuracy over the full analysis...
